title: El mundo cambia
goal: Read what actually triggered Latin American independence: not simply accumulated resentment, but a specific 1808 crisis in Spain, plus a nearby revolution that inspired and terrified in equal measure.

items: Explain how Enlightenment ideas reached criollo readers despite censorship.
Explain what happened in Spain in 1808 and why it mattered.
Describe how Spanish American juntas justified their new autonomy.
Explain why Haiti's 1804 independence provoked such mixed reactions.
Use passive voice to describe how ideas and events spread and were received.
